The class period covers securities purchased between August 1, 2025 and May 15, 2026.

top.title: Trevogrumab Clinical, Regulatory and Commercial Intelligence Report 2026: Phase II Data Show Improved Lean Mass Preservation
top.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals' trevogrumab, a myostatin-targeting monoclonal antibody, shows promise in Phase II trials for preserving lean mass in obesity treatment when combined with semaglutide. Updated 26-week COURAGE trial data indicate trevogrumab prevented approximately half of the lean mass loss associated with semaglutide, addressing a significant unmet medical need. The drug is also being investigated for sarcopenia and musculoskeletal disorders across seven major markets through 2034.

top.title: Will The Recent Pipeline Progress Boost BMY's Portfolio Expansion?
top.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced positive Phase II results for arlo-cel, a first-in-class GPRC5D-directed CAR T cell therapy, in heavily pretreated multiple myeloma patients. The QUINTESSENTIAL study met its primary endpoint showing statistically significant overall response rates in quadruple-class exposed patients. This positions BMY to treat patients resistant to BCMA-directed therapies, broadening its multiple myeloma portfolio alongside recently approved Zenbexus.

top.title: SOTYKTU Clinical, Regulatory and Commercial Intelligence Report 2026
top.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's SOTYKTU (deucravacitinib), a first-in-class TYK2 inhibitor, has received FDA approval for psoriatic arthritis in March 2026, expanding its commercial potential beyond plaque psoriasis. The drug demonstrates sustained efficacy with PASI 75 response rates of 67%-73% through five years and over 5,000 patient-years of safety data. Market analysis forecasts SOTYKTU sales across seven major markets through 2034, with growth driven by oral convenience, selective mechanism of action, and potential expansion into additional immune-mediated inflammatory disease indications including lupus, Sjogren's syndrome, and Crohn's disease.

top.title: Monoclonal Antibodies Market to Grow at 11.01% CAGR, Reaching USD 791.28 Billion by 2035 – SNS Insider
top.summary: The global monoclonal antibodies market is projected to grow from USD 280.15 billion in 2025 to USD 791.28 billion by 2035, driven by increasing demand for targeted therapies in oncology, autoimmune disorders, and chronic diseases. North America leads with 41% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth at 12.32% CAGR. Key innovations include bispecific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates, with humanized antibodies emerging as the fastest-growing segment.

top.title: Radioligand Therapy Market to Grow from USD 2.98 Billion in 2025 to USD 15.85 Billion by 2035, at a CAGR of 18.2% - SNS Insider
top.summary: The radioligand therapy market is projected to grow at an 18.2% CAGR through 2035, driven by increased prostate cancer and neuroendocrine tumor cases, FDA approvals for PSMA-targeted therapies like Pluvicto, and expanded isotope production capacity. North America dominates with 80.5% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 21.5% CAGR.

The decline reflects investor concerns over backlog contraction from $2.9B to $2.5B, deteriorating margins (gross margin fell to 19.3%, Industrial margin to 7.3%), and unpredictable project award timing. While the company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and strong growth metrics, elevated valuation at 33.1X trailing earnings and execution risks keep the investment case uncertain.
